title: chore(tests): make main widget render test snapshot smaller
body:
**Summary**

This test was constantly flaking for me for changed behaviour with keys of `null` which didn't matter for this snapshot.

**Result**

I shortened the snapshot used in this test by using matchers for the relevant parts of this test.

I wanted to use `expect.any(AlgoliaSearchHelper)` and `expect.any(SearchParameters)`, but that didn't work (I think jest didn't recognise it as classes?).
